results.rationale: Consistency: Face, room and clothing colors persist, but the intact right arm/hand pose and lower shoe/leg positions change. Instruction: The extra central arm and hand are removed, leaving two anatomically plausible arms. Quality: The seated figure, hands, clothes and painterly background are coherent.

Consistency: The supplied black-and-gold fountain pen remains recognizable with its diagonal orientation and details; the background replacement is instructed. Instruction: The supplied source is a pen rather than a bear balloon. The edit adds a right-side bear, clouds, stars, sweets and blue background, but the title is malformed as Hiar Bauloon Tapty and the bear lacks a clear balloon string. Quality: Bold clean graphics are undermined by several garbled title words and the dominant pen/bear composition.
